newsitem.title: UK: PizzaExpress may spend 25 mln stg on outlets.
newsitem.headline: PizzaExpress may spend 25 mln stg on outlets.

text.p: Pizza Express Plc said on Monday it was in talks to buy up to 32 of its remaining franchised restaurants and one independent restaurant for a total consideration of about 25 million stg.

Pizza Express, which said it would make a further announcement once a deal had been sealed, said last week that it was in talks that may lead to the acquisition of "a number of the remaining franchised restaurants".
The company confirmed that it was still in negotiations after weekend newspaper comment about the potential purchase.
